title: The technology to eradicate mosquito-borne disease exists
summary: An investigative article from Works in Progress exploring existing technologies like gene editing and biological control methods that could potentially eliminate mosquito-borne diseases such as malaria, dengue, and Zika, which collectively kill over 700,000 people annually.
problem_solved: Mosquito-borne diseases that kill hundreds of thousands of people yearly through bites
why_valuable: Demonstrates that humanity already possesses the technical means to prevent a massive global health burden, raising questions about why deployment hasn't scaled
